column4: New to this base: the MEC *Referencial para Desenvolvimento e Uso Responsáveis de Inteligência Artificial na Educação* is **241 pages**, published **March 2026**, and shipped alongside a **regulatory sandbox built with the AGU** (Advocacia-Geral da União). Civil society (Campanha Nacional pelo Direito à Educação) filed contributions arguing the text needed firmer normative grounding. Also returned: Projeto ConsciêncIA, a web platform from a UFMS Faculdade de Computação extension project with SBC/EduComp and WEI papers; a "IA na prática docente" course on Plataforma Mais Professores; Paraná as the first state to offer a public technical course in AI. 🔴 NO result states a repository, a public code location or a licence for ANY of them. 🔴 DATE CORRECTION, caught by a second leg before publication: the first leg returned a public consultation "aberta na plataforma Brasil Participativo até 29 de outubro" with no year. A verification leg places it in **OCTOBER 2025**, not 2026 — the consultation that PRECEDED the March 2026 Referencial. Published as live it would have handed a studio a deadline 11 days out that closed a year ago. 🔵 p223's date gate exists for exactly this shape.

column2: ASEAN Education Ministers Meeting 2026 artificial intelligence declaration Singapore ethical AI education
column3: 🟢 CORROBORATED by four independent outlets and ONE primary source IDENTIFIED
column4: The **14th ASEAN Education Ministers Meeting**, Singapore, **2026-07-22**, launched the **ASEAN Work Plan on Education 2026-2030**, with **AI readiness, STEM capability and holistic student development** as its three anchors; AI readiness is framed as "updating curricula, teaching methods and assessments". Minister **Desmond Lee** delivered it; **Singapore chairs ASEAN education 2026-2027**; **Brunei** hosts the 15th; Indonesian coverage counts **15 joint-statement points**. Separately a **Philippines-hosted ASEAN Higher Education Policy Dialogue** statement covers AI-enabled learning, ethical AI use, lifelong learning and faculty development, listed for notation at the **49th ASEAN Leaders' Summit**. 🔴 Source conflict, unresolved: one report credits the Philippines with the 2026 ASEAN chairmanship while Singapore's own government page and Malaysian coverage describe Singapore as education chair — plausibly different roles, but no source reconciles them and this base asserts neither. 🔴 NO standalone "ethical AI declaration" text was found; the work plan and the HE statement are different documents and are recorded as such.
